title: Ovicopter

moves.title: Lay Eggs
effects: Summon 3 ToughEgg minions (if 3 or fewer allies are alive)

move_pattern: Starts with Lay Eggs → Smash → Tenderizer. After Tenderizer: if 3 or fewer allies are alive, repeats Lay Eggs; if more than 3 allies, does Nutritional Paste instead (then back to Smash → Tenderizer).
notes: Summon-based monster that adapts its strategy based on board crowding. Normally spawns ToughEgg minions, but switches to self-buffing (Strength) when more than 3 allies are alive to avoid overcrowding the battlefield. Tenderizer weakens the player's defense with Vulnerable, amplifying the threat of subsequent attacks.
